recommendation_summary: Once a year, create an event in the existing phone calendar for each contract, dated 14 days before its notice deadline, with a notification enabled. Each event lists the contract name, notice deadline and renewal date, and the entries are checked against the statement. It offers no optional additions and leaves no needs unmet; cancellations and payments stay manual.
